title: DetectionEvent
description: Vehicle detection event emitted by a PRAVAAH AI-engine camera worker to the Kafka 'detections' topic.

event_id.description: UUID v4 — unique per event, used as a deduplication key.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of frame capture (not Kafka ingestion time).

plate_text.description: OCR result after multi-frame voting. Empty string if plate was unreadable.

plate_confidence.description: Aggregate confidence score (0.0–1.0) combining detector, OCR, and voting agreement.

vehicle_type.description: YOLO-detected vehicle class mapped to the platform taxonomy.

bbox.description: Vehicle bounding box in source frame pixels [x1, y1, x2, y2] (top-left, bottom-right).

track_id.description: ByteTrack track ID scoped per camera. Global ID = camera_id + ':' + track_id.

snapshot_url.description: Relative URL to JPEG snapshot served by the backend. Empty string on failure.

plate_format_invalid.description: True when plate_text does not match the Indian plate regex. Set by validator.

confidence_tier.description: Confidence bucket computed from plate_confidence. Set by stream processor.

appearance_embedding.description: OSNet 512-dim appearance embedding for Re-ID fallback (Phase 6+). Optional.

is_synthetic.description: True for all events produced by the synthetic generator. Absent on real AI-engine events. Stream processors must exclude synthetic events from real analytics.

synthetic_scenario_id.description: Scenario tag for planted vehicles, e.g. NORMAL_ROUTE, BLACKLIST_HIT, IMPOSSIBLE_TRAVEL, background. Only present when is_synthetic is true.

plate_detector_method.description: Plate detection method: 'model' = yasirfaizahmed/license-plate-object-detection, 'heuristic' = bottom-crop fallback (--allow-heuristic-fallback required). Absent when source is video (OCR skipped). plate_confidence is hard-capped at 0.49 when heuristic.
